content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary of review (ASSIGN — Paragraph 22, Assignment of Rights and Obligations):**

- **Our side is protected already:** 22.1's general bar is subject to 22.2–22.5, and 22.3 lets a Party assign the whole of its rights and obligations to a successor, Parent Company, Subsidiary or Affiliate without consent (22.6 requires only timely written notice). 22.4/22.5 add partial affiliate assignments. So preferred elements 1 and 2 are met verbatim, and I did not disturb them.
- **Counterparty side fails:** because the carve-outs are symmetric, every other APCN 2 Party can assign to its own successors and affiliates without our consent; consent under 22.2 runs to the Management Committee, not to us, and there is no competitor bar. The fallback ("other assignments require consent") is also not satisfied given the retained no-consent affiliate exception — but curing it at the fallback would mean surrendering our own affiliate rights, so I targeted **preferred** instead.
- **No change-of-control termination right** exists anywhere (Paragraph 18 duration/termination and Paragraph 12 capacity transfers checked); the new clause confirms this rather than creating a new mechanic. Paragraph 12.4 capacity assignment was reviewed and not double-flagged.
- **Redline:** one new Subparagraph 22.7 conforming 22.2–22.5, validated with `ok:true` and passing the minimality gate.
